title.en: Query a time server without changing your clock
title.hinglish: Apni clock badle bina time server se pucho

why.en: Sends one NTP request and prints the offset and delay, the two numbers computed from the four timestamps. It does not set your clock.
why.hinglish: Ek NTP request bhejta hai aur offset aur delay print karta hai, wo do numbers jo chaar timestamps se nikalte hain. Ye aapki clock set nahi karta.

expect.en: Windows prints a few lines of time and an offset such as '+00.0123456s'. sntp prints something like '+0.004 +/- 0.020 time.google.com'. The numbers depend on your clock and network.
expect.hinglish: Windows kuch lines time aur '+00.0123456s' jaisa offset print karta hai. sntp '+0.004 +/- 0.020 time.google.com' jaisa kuch print karta hai. Numbers aapki clock aur network pe depend karte hain.

title.en: Check your own clock's sync status
title.hinglish: Apni clock ka sync status check karo

why.en: Shows which server your machine syncs from, its stratum and the last offset.
why.hinglish: Dikhata hai ki aapki machine kaunse server se sync hoti hai, uska stratum aur last offset.

expect.en: Fields such as Stratum, Source and Last Successful Sync Time (Windows) or Server, Stratum and Offset (Linux with systemd-timesyncd). Output varies; macOS has no equivalent, use 'sntp time.apple.com'.
expect.hinglish: Stratum, Source aur Last Successful Sync Time (Windows) ya Server, Stratum aur Offset (systemd-timesyncd wala Linux) jaise fields. Output alag hota hai; macOS mein iska equivalent nahi, 'sntp time.apple.com' use karo.

title.en: Find the NTP packets in the capture

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark and filter for NTP, then expand the packet to see T1 to T4.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur NTP filter karo, phir packet expand karke T1 se T4 dekho.

expect.en: Pairs of mode 3 (client) and mode 4 (server) packets on UDP port 123, each 48 bytes, with Originate, Receive and Transmit timestamps.
expect.hinglish: UDP port 123 pe mode 3 (client) aur mode 4 (server) packets ki jodiyan, har ek 48 bytes, Originate, Receive aur Transmit timestamps ke saath.
